title: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty
grouping: Top half: a narrow rounded container 'target LLM' at the left and a wide rounded container 'Draft model' cut by vertical dashed lines into three columns, each with a footer tag 'Forward 1/2/3'. Bottom half: the resulting token tree, with horizontal dashed blue lines separating 'Query', 'Sampling using Original LLM' and 'Drafting' bands and the same Forward tags stacked to its right as a legend.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded bars span the containers for shared layers (pale blue 'LM Head' and 'Embedding' with small snowflake icons, a pale yellow 'One Auto-regression Head'). Per-position features are small pink boxes with typeset f_word labels stacked on green e_word boxes; tokens are white rounded boxes with words, the drafted ones outlined in red. Orange dashed arrows carry features from one forward to the next; black dashed lines link sampled tokens to the next input. The bottom tree uses green dashed rounded nodes.
proposed_highlight: The only trainable module is the single yellow bar; frozen layers carry snowflakes; drafted tokens are red-outlined; grey versus yellow footer tags separate the target model's forward from the draft model's forwards in both halves.
lesson: Cut the draft model into vertical columns, one per forward pass, each with a coloured footer tag, and repeat those tags beside the levels of the draft token tree below, so every tree level maps to the forward pass that produced it.
notes: Venue from Semantic Scholar (ICML 2024); arXiv year 2024 agrees.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: speculative sampling for faster LLM decoding

core.what: the draft model is unrolled over three forward passes as columns of one wide container split by vertical dashed lines and tagged Forward 1/2/3 in a footer, beside a narrow target-LLM container whose features are fed into it

relations.form: one wide rounded 'Draft model' container cut by vertical dashed lines into three columns, the shared Embedding, Auto-regression Head and LM Head bars spanning all columns, with yellow Forward 1/2/3 footer tags

the narrow 'target LLM' container on the left (Embedding, Transformer Layers, LM Head) stands beside the wide draft container, which replaces the Transformer layers with one yellow 'One Auto-regression Head' bar
each draft input is a stacked pair, a pink feature f over a green embedding e; orange dashed elbow lines bring each feature from the target LLM or from the previous draft column into the next pair

tokens flow bottom to top within each column (token -> embedding -> head -> feature -> LM Head -> sampling -> token), and black dashed lines carry sampled tokens back down into the next column's input

below the containers the drafted continuation is a token tree in three banded rows (Query 'How can', 'I' sampled by the original LLM, then dashed-outline drafted tokens make/help, a/our, with/you, ...), with the Forward tags repeated at the right

channels.colour: pink = feature vector, green = token embedding, light blue = frozen module (with a snowflake icon), yellow = the trainable auto-regression head; the footer tags use grey for the target forward and the same yellow for draft forwards, so yellow means both 'trainable head' and 'draft pass'; red outline = a draft-produced token or feature versus black for target-produced
channels.shape: wide rounded bar = layer shared across positions, small rectangle = token or vector, dashed-outline rounded box = drafted token in the tree
channels.line: solid black arrows = forward within a pass; orange dashed elbows = feature hand-off; black dashed = sampled-token hand-off; light-blue dashed rules = band separators in the tree
channels.frame: rounded containers = one model (target LLM, draft model); vertical dashed lines = one forward pass

quality.strengths: Unrolling the draft passes as columns that share spanning layer bars shows directly that one small head is reused per step, and the snowflake/yellow contrast picks out the only trainable part; features and embeddings are drawn as named vectors (f_how, e_can) between the modules that make and use them; the token tree below gives the output as data.
quality.weaknesses: Orange dashed feature lines bend repeatedly and cross column boundaries, making the one-step feature shift hard to follow; yellow carries two meanings and red outlines (draft-produced) are never keyed; the tree is a separate panel whose rows are tied to the columns only by repeated Forward tags rather than by alignment.

insights.structure: Top half: a narrow rounded 'target LLM' container at left and a wide 'Draft model' container cut by vertical dashed lines into three columns with footer tags Forward 1/2/3; bottom half: the resulting token tree in banded rows (Query, Sampling using Original LLM, Drafting) with the Forward tags repeated at right.
insights.data: Tokens are white rounded word boxes (drafted ones red-outlined); per-position features are pink f_word boxes stacked on green e_word embedding boxes; the tree uses green dashed rounded nodes.
insights.emphasis: The only trainable module is a single yellow 'One Auto-regression Head' bar spanning the draft model, frozen LM Head and Embedding bars carry snowflake icons, and grey vs yellow footer tags separate the target model's forward from the draft forwards.
insights.flow: Bottom to top within each model column; orange dashed arrows carry features from one forward column to the next, and black dashed lines carry sampled tokens back down to become the next input.
insights.avoid: Orange and black dashed lines cross the column dividers in several places and overlap each other, which makes the feature hand-off between forwards hard to trace.

arrangement.units: top: two rounded containers (target LLM, draft model split into three forward columns by dashed lines); bottom: a token tree split into horizontal bands by dashed blue rules
arrangement.inputs_as: word token boxes ('How', 'can') at the bottom of each column
arrangement.shared: Forward 1/2/3 colour tags reused under the draft columns and beside the tree levels
